title: Event
description: A discrete in-round event (kill, plant, defuse, ...). Field shape mirrors the VLR 2D-replay log event actually observed in vctstats (keys t/type/by/vid/pos/from/locs). FUTURE for real data (requires a match whose vlr.gg page carries 2D-replay data); POPULATED for synthetic rounds. Each event carries an optional position snapshot of all players (see `positions`).

eventNum.description: 0-based index of the event within the round (ordering key).

type.description: Event kind. kill/plant/defuse are directly observed in replay logs; spike_death/environment_death are DERIVED (victim is own killer in the log); round_start/round_end are synthetic/structural markers.

timeMs.description: Time since round barriers dropped, in milliseconds. Real source gives 'M:SS' round-clock, converted to ms (vctstats clock() * 1000). Round combat clock is ROUND_SECONDS=100s before plant; after plant the spike timer (SPIKE_SECONDS=45s) governs.

actorPlayerId.description: Player who caused the event (killer/planter/defuser). Null for spike/environment deaths.

victimPlayerId.description: Player affected (victim of a kill). Null for plant/defuse.

weapon.description: Weapon/cause title from the kill feed, e.g. 'Vandal', 'Operator', 'Spike'.

site.description: Plant site letter for plant/defuse events.

afterDetonation.description: True if this event happened after the spike detonated (DERIVED from the replay 'boom' index).

positions.description: Snapshot of all players' positions at this event's moment (the replay `locs` array). This is the Layer-B spatial signal; it is event-triggered (sparse), not continuous.
